name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.255: A correction that buys its gain by landing on a SONG is now taken back. The
    objective is the mean level in the voice band under a cue, and sung vocals are louder there
    than speech: on The Rainmaker S02E01 the opening block scored 0.640 placed on the title song
    against 0.538 where the dialogue actually is, so the fit moved 58 cues 15.5 s early and wrote
    two of them as 00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:00,000. Mean level cannot tell the two apart, but the
    ONSET at a cue start can — the level jumps when speech starts and does not jump over a
    through-composed song. Each segment is now checked after the fit: if it wins at least 0.10
    mean level over the unshifted placement while its cue starts show no onset, it takes its
    NEIGHBOUR's shift instead, the level the file already proves right next door. Calibrated on
    46 subtitles: exactly one segment in the corpus reaches the 0.10 floor (Rainmaker, +0.132,
    against a next-highest 0.057), so nothing else changes — Rainmaker now lands on −2.00 s, the
    same shift as the rest of its file, instead of −15.50 s.
